properties.description: **Professional** — Active security posture for Defender for Cloud: controls that produce signals an operations team must act on. This tier delivers Microsoft Defender plans surfacing threat signals, vulnerability assessment scanning, network hardening (public access disabled, VNet integration, firewall rules), privileged identity management and just-in-time access, audit-log and monitoring controls that produce signals for ops teams, and auto-remediation deployments. Together these policies protect against…
